visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a extreme close-up of a bowl of noodle soup featuring a large, purple-brown grilled squid. A hand uses black chopsticks to lift a slice of the squid, revealing white interior meat. The lighting is bright and warm. (2) Transition to a kitchen setting where a hand pours clear broth from a plastic pitcher into a small pot containing clams, meat slices, and fish cakes. (3) A dollop of red chili paste is added to the simmering soup. A person wearing purple gloves and a black mask adds a bundle of yellow fried noodles and green vegetables into the pot. (4) The noodles are stirred with metal tongs in the pot. A separate shot shows the noodles being poured into a white and blue patterned bowl. A hand slices the whole grilled squid with a knife. (5) Close-up shots feature various toppings being lifted: a thin slice of pork, a golden-brown fried tofu block, and a small fish ball. The broth is a creamy orange-red color. (6) A second bowl of noodles is introduced, this time with a darker red spicy broth poured over it. Instant-style wavy noodles are lifted to show their texture. (7) A tray of golden-brown fried chicken pieces is shown. A piece is dipped into a small dish of red ketchup-like sauce. (8) A third bowl with clear, yellowish broth is presented. A spoon scoops up the broth, then a small dish of brown shacha sauce is poured onto the noodles. (9) A spoonful of several cooked clams is lifted high. The video concludes with a shot of the clean, modern restaurant interior with wooden tables and a view of the storefront entrance from the street.
